description: Generate a pure tone at any frequency from 20 Hz to 20 kHz — choose sine, square, sawtooth or triangle waves, with volume control.

faqs.a: 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz — the full range of human hearing — set by slider or exact number.
Slide the frequency while playing to sweep — useful for finding rattles or testing speakers.
faqs.q: Can I sweep the frequency live?

faqs.a: Keep the volume low, especially with headphones, and avoid long exposure to very high volumes.
faqs.q: Is it safe for my ears?

howto: Set the frequency with the slider or type it exactly.
Press Play and adjust the volume.
Slide the frequency live to sweep.
title: Tone Frequency Generator
